data.description: Nationals of Indonesia appear neither on the National Immigration Administration's unilateral visa-exemption list nor among the bilateral reciprocal exemption agreements: a visa sticker must be obtained before departure. The application goes through the COVA online form of the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then through an in-person submission at a CVASC visa application centre or at the competent consulate. China issues no e-visa, no visa on arrival and no electronic travel authorisation for tourism.
documents_required: Ordinary passport valid for more than 6 months with at least two blank facing pages
COVA form completed online at visa.mfa.gov.cn, printed, dated and signed by hand
Recent colour passport photo on a white background, 33 x 48 mm, bare head and face uncovered
Return flight bookings and hotel confirmations covering the whole stay, or a letter of invitation from a host or a company in China
Proof of residence status in the country of filing if you are not a national there (residence permit, long-stay visa)
Old passport or copy of previous Chinese visas, if you have already been issued any
Additional documents depending on the type applied for: official PU/TE invitation letter for business, JW201/JW202 admission for studies, marriage or birth certificate for family visits
process: Complete the COVA form at visa.mfa.gov.cn, generate the application number and print the signed version
Book an appointment on the portal of the competent CVASC centre (visaforchina.cn); the geographical jurisdiction is strict, each consulate handles only its own district
Submit the file in person: fingerprints are compulsory for ages 14-70, except for a waiver where a visa was recently issued by the same post
Pay the consular and service fees, generally when collecting the passport and according to the payment methods accepted by the centre
Collect the passport with the sticker and immediately check the number of entries, the authorised length of stay and the entry deadline
On arrival in China, have your place of residence registered within 24 hours: the hotel takes care of it, otherwise you must go to the neighbourhood police station (paichusuo)

extension.details: The extension is applied for on the spot at the exit-entry bureau of the Public Security Bureau (PSB, churuJing guanli) of the city of stay, generally for an additional 30 days and only once. The file must be submitted at least 7 days before the authorised stay expires, with passport, form, photo, proof of residence registration and evidence of the reason for the extension. Processing takes about 7 working days during which the passport stays at the PSB; overstaying is punished by a daily fine, possible detention and a ban on return.

data.description: Nationals of Indonesia are not on the list of 66 nationalities eligible for the Saudi eVisa published on visa.visitsaudi.com: they must obtain a visa from an embassy or consulate of Saudi Arabia before departure, as the official portal explicitly refers applicants to the nearest mission. The application is filed through the approved processing centre of the country of residence and the visa is affixed in the passport. A derogation route exists for certain holders of a valid visa or residence permit of the United States, the United Kingdom or the Schengen Area, but it remains conditional and does not change the baseline regime attached to nationality.
documents_required: Passport valid for at least six months after the date of arrival, with two blank pages for the sticker and stamps
Application form completed online (Enjaz portal or the unified ksavisa.sa platform), printed and signed
Recent identity photographs on a white background, in the format required by the Saudi mission
Proof of purpose: hotel booking and itinerary for tourism, or a letter of invitation from a Saudi entity for a business trip
Confirmed return ticket and proof of sufficient funds for the duration of the stay
Health insurance covering the entire stay in Saudi Arabia
ACWY meningococcal vaccination certificate for Umrah and Hajj, and proof of polio vaccination if you are coming from an affected country
process: Identify the Saudi embassy or consulate with jurisdiction over your country of residence and the approved processing centre to which it delegates submissions
Complete the application online on the Enjaz portal or ksavisa.sa and print the form with its barcode
Have the required documents certified: for a business file, the invitation goes through the chamber of commerce and then the ministry of foreign affairs of the issuing country
Submit the complete file, provide your biometrics and pay the consular fees as well as the centre's service fees
Collect the passport and check on the sticker the category, the number of entries, the entry deadline and the length of stay granted
On arrival in Riyadh (RUH), Jeddah (JED), Dammam (DMM) or Medina (MED), pass immigration control with fingerprinting and photograph

extension.details: Some visit visas can be extended from within Saudi Arabia by the Saudi sponsor or host through the Absher and Muqeem platforms, before the expiry date and against payment of a fee; the decision remains discretionary. Pilgrimage visas and single-purpose visit visas cannot be extended. Overstaying exposes you to a fine, to deportation and to a re-entry ban, liability being shared with the sponsor.

data.description: Nationals of Indonesia fall under the United Arab Emirates' default regime: they must obtain an entry permit BEFORE departure, and it must be sponsored by a UAE-based entity (airline, hotel, approved travel agency, company or resident relative). The UAE has neither a government self-service e-visa nor an ETA for tourists: the application is filed online, but always through the sponsor or via the ICP smart services. Since 25 June 2026, a few nationalities (India, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Kenya, South Africa) may instead obtain a paid visa on arrival, provided they hold a valid residence permit from the United States, the EU, the United Kingdom, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand or Canada.
documents_required: Passport valid for at least 6 months on the date of entry, with one blank page
Recent identity photo on a white background, digital format compliant with the ICP templates
Proof of the UAE sponsor: confirmed hotel booking, company invitation letter, or copy of the resident relative's Emirates ID
Return or onward air ticket with fixed dates
Proof of financial means (bank statements for the last 3 to 6 months depending on the sponsor)
For the paid visa on arrival: valid residence permit from the USA, the EU, the UK, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand or Canada, valid for at least 6 months
Travel insurance certificate covering medical expenses in the UAE (required by most sponsors)
process: Identify your sponsor: the airline (Emirates, Etihad, flydubai, Air Arabia) at the time of booking, the hotel, an approved UAE agency, or the employer/the resident relative
File the application via the ICP smart services (icp.gov.ae) or, for a stay in Dubai, via the GDRFA (gdrfad.gov.ae), or let the sponsor file it for you
Upload passport, photo and supporting documents, then pay the fees online (rates vary according to the duration and the sponsor)
Track the application with the application number and receive the electronic entry permit by e-mail, with no sticker in the passport
Print the permit and present it with the passport at check-in and then at immigration; the smart gates open only once entry has been registered
Paid visa on arrival: go to the dedicated airport counter with the foreign residence permit and pay 100 AED (14 days) or 250 AED (60 days)

extension.details: The 30- and 60-day tourist permits can generally be extended once or twice for 30 days without leaving the country, via the ICP smart services, a typing centre agency or the sponsor, on payment of fees set by the ICP. The application must be filed BEFORE expiry: beyond that, a daily fine accrues automatically and blocks departure until it is paid at the airport. The 14-day paid visa on arrival can be extended once for 14 days; the 60-day one is not systematically extendable.

data.max_stay: 30 or 60 days depending on the permit; 14 or 60 days for the paid VOA
